question: Which of the following countries is the winner of the FIFA Football World Cup 2022 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Argentina**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Argentina** won the FIFA Football World Cup 2022 held in Qatar, defeating **France** in the final match.
 
• The final match was played on **18 December 2022**, at the Lusail Iconic Stadium in Lusail, Qatar.
 
• The match ended in a dramatic 3-3 draw after extra time, with Argentina clinching the title after a 4-2 penalty shootout victory</strong
